thread:
nina: Quick review request for wording in the 'discard draft' confirmation on the dashboard editor. Trying to keep it friendly but clear about data loss. Draft below.

nina: ```
Header: Discard draft
Body: Discarding this draft will remove any unsaved changes. This action cannot be undone.
Primary CTA: Discard draft
Secondary CTA: Keep editing
Helper text (small): Tip: Press Ctrl+Z to undo recent edits (may not restore all changes)
```

rajesh: I like 'Keep editing' as the safe option. Suggest changing 'cannot be undone' to 'cannot be recovered' feels slightly softer.

becky: Accessibility nit: default focus should be on 'Keep editing'. Also the helper line with Ctrl+Z could be confusing on Mac; use platform-agnostic wording or show both (Ctrl/Cmd).

nina: Good point. How about: 'Press Ctrl/Cmd+Z to undo recent edits (may not restore everything)'?

rajesh: That works. Legal: we're not promising recovery so 'may not restore everything' is cautious enough.

legal-bot: Automated check: phrase 'cannot be recovered' preferred over 'cannot be undone' for source strings. Flagging for review.

becky: UX nit: consider changing primary CTA to 'Discard changes' — clearer than 'Discard draft' for users who created the draft earlier. But both ok.

nina: I'll switch to 'Discard changes' as primary and update header to 'Discard changes' to match. Final draft below.

nina: ```
Header: Discard changes
Body: Discarding these changes will remove any unsaved edits. This action cannot be recovered.
Primary CTA: Discard changes
Secondary CTA: Keep editing
Helper text (small): Press Ctrl/Cmd+Z to undo recent edits (may not restore everything)
```

rajesh: :thumbsup: Please add an aria-live announcement for screen readers that states 'Changes discarded' after the action completes.

becky: I'll file the accessibility task. Nina, can you also include i18n keys and avoid contractions in source strings?

nina: On it. Thanks everyone! Leaving thread open until legal-bot confirm full phrasing.
